sloka: मेघ उदर विनिर्मुक्ताः कर्पूर दल शीतलाः ।शक्यम् अंजलिभिः पातुम् वाताः केतकि गन्धिनः ॥४-२८-८॥
transliteration: megha udara vinirmuktāḥ karpūra dala śītalāḥ ।śakyam aṁjalibhiḥ pātum vātāḥ ketaki gandhinaḥ ॥4-28-8॥

translations.english: 'The winds released from the wombs of clouds, cool as the delicate touch of white lotuses,charged with the fragrance of ketaka flowers can be inhaled through the hollow of one's palms.
